metadata.description: Starter tuning history extracted from .claude/context.md BSA sessions, git log, and R2 consultant CSV observations. Used as prompt context for AI-assisted config tuning feature.

bsaCriticalThresholds.description: These 5 values are BSA compliance-approved and tested in production. Do NOT suggest changes to these without a full R2 validation run.

currentConfig.description: Production parameter values as of 2026-03-18 (BSA-validated, 100/100 passing)

tuningRounds.description: Phonetic word order insensitivity — initial BSA phonetic fix
tuningRounds.trigger: BSA consultant observation: phonetic matching not word-order independent
tuningRounds.notes: First phonetic matching fix — established pattern for subsequent phonetic tuning

tuningRounds.description: S.I. 5 CECOEX — Soundex false positive (CECOEX matched CHACHAJEE via S562 Soundex collision)
tuningRounds.trigger: CECOEX search returning LAKHVI entity (which has CHACHAJEE alias). Soundex S562 collision.

changesApplied.rationale: Tighten phonetic length threshold from 30% to 10% to prevent Soundex false positives on short tokens

tuningRounds.notes: CECOEX (6 chars) vs CHACHAJEE (9 chars) = 50% length diff → now rejected. Muhammad (8) vs Mohammad (8) = 0% diff → still accepted.

tuningRounds.description: Broad phonetic matching — Rows 13, 16, 18, 24 (SHINRIKYO/SUNRISE Soundex collision S562, PIJ/PKK collision P200)
tuningRounds.trigger: Short strings colliding via Soundex. PIJ matching PKK. SHINRIKYO matching SUNRISE.

changesApplied.rationale: Tokens shorter than 3 chars excluded from phonetic matching to prevent 3-letter Soundex collisions
Short-code entity detection threshold — entities where most tokens are short (vessels, aircraft IDs) use different matching path

tuningRounds.notes: Soundex too coarse for 3-char tokens. PIJ (P200) = PKK (P200) collide. Minimum length requirement prevents this class of false positive.

tuningRounds.description: Legal suffix removal — Rows 12, 23, 30, 38, 39, 42, 52. S.A., OOO, OJSC not being stripped before comparison.
tuningRounds.trigger: Stopword removal was running BEFORE company suffix removal. 'S.A.' → 's a' → 'a' removed as stopword → 's' left over, breaking suffix matching.
tuningRounds.algorithmChange: Pipeline order fix in Entity.normalize(): punctuation removal → company suffix removal → stopword removal. Suffix list expanded from 13 to 37 entries.
tuningRounds.notes: Not a parameter change — a pipeline order bug. Go implementation had it right. Key insight: order matters, and stopwords ('a','c','v') were destroying Spanish/Russian suffixes.

tuningRounds.description: Row 15 GHAILANI — FOOPIE/FUPI aliases not extracted. OFAC uses double single-quotes: a.k.a. ''FOOPIE'' instead of 'FOOPIE'.
tuningRounds.trigger: BSA consultant confirmed FOOPIE and FUPI are in OFAC data but not appearing in search results.
tuningRounds.algorithmChange: RemarksParser.java regex: ALIAS_PATTERN changed from `'([^']+)'` to `'+([^']+)'+` (one-or-more quotes on each side)
tuningRounds.notes: OFAC data inconsistency — not all entries use standard single quotes. Regex must handle double-quote format.

tuningRounds.description: 7 BSA observations (Rows 6, 21, 22, 52 entity + Rows 1, 6, 7 individual) reported 'missing entities'. Root cause: admin.html hardcoded limit=5.
tuningRounds.trigger: BSA consultant: 'UI defaults to displaying only the top 5 results — introduces operational visibility concern.'
tuningRounds.uiChange: admin.html: limit input changed from hardcoded 5 to configurable input (default 50, max 100)
tuningRounds.bsaResultAfter: All 7 observations resolved — entities were present but at positions 6-9
tuningRounds.notes: NOT a scoring bug. All 'missing' entities scored 100% and ranked in top 10. Single UI config issue caused 7 observation failures. Always verify with full result sets.

tuningRounds.description: S.I. 50 matchedAlias metadata bug — alias tie-breaking failing for Row 50 individual
tuningRounds.trigger: matchedAlias field not being populated correctly, causing tie-breaker to not prefer alias match
tuningRounds.algorithmChange: EntityScorerImpl: Fixed matchedAlias population in tie-breaking logic
tuningRounds.notes: Metadata bug, not a scoring weight issue

tuningRounds.description: Row 31 BSA regression — entity normalization and tie-breaker acronym handling (52/52 passing after fix)
tuningRounds.trigger: Row 31 regression introduced by prior fixes. Acronym handling in tie-breaker was inconsistent.
tuningRounds.notes: Regression from prior fix. Acronym collapsing must be consistent between scoring and tie-breaking paths.

tuningRounds.description: BSA Groups 2 and 5 — acronym collapsing and query coverage boost
tuningRounds.trigger: Short-form entity names (acronyms) not matching their expanded forms reliably. Query coverage calculation not boosting high-quality full matches.

changesApplied.rationale: Minimum token-avg score to trigger coverage boost — ensures boost only fires on high-quality full matches
8% score boost when all query tokens match at high quality — rewards precise matches over partial ones

tuningRounds.notes: Coverage boost rewards queries where every token matches well — combats scenarios where a longer but less relevant entity outscores the correct shorter match.

tuningRounds.description: Rows 21, 22, 6, 35 — related entity coverage. Limit unique entities before alias expansion was cutting off valid results.
tuningRounds.trigger: AL QA'IDA, TALIBAN entities not appearing in top results when querying related organization names
tuningRounds.algorithmChange: SearchServiceImpl: Changed entity deduplication to happen before alias expansion, not after — ensures unique entities are selected then all their aliases are considered
tuningRounds.notes: Alias expansion was being limited by the entity limit. Fix: select N unique entities first, then expand aliases for all of them.

tuningRounds.description: Migrated 9 BSA compliance thresholds to YAML (35 total params). SimilarityConfig expanded to 12 params, WeightConfig to 20 params.
tuningRounds.trigger: Production tuning required code changes + recompilation. BSA consultant testing needed runtime adjustability.

changesApplied.rationale: Externalize BSA-validated phonetic threshold to YAML
Prefer alias match when both entity and alias score ≥ 0.95
Score boost applied when alias is the best match
BSA-tuned threshold for alias candidate selection — raised from ~0.70 to reduce false alias promotions

tuningRounds.notes: This was a milestone: moved from scattered hardcoded values to centralized YAML. The values themselves were already BSA-validated — this was a configurability improvement, not a scoring change.

tuningRounds.description: R2 Row 17 (CK ID CO. LTD) — partial name 'CK ID' not returning main entity. Fixed by alias boost threshold change.
tuningRounds.trigger: BSA consultant R2 retest: 'Partial-name search missed valid entity result' for CK ID

changesApplied.rationale: Alias boost was being applied universally (1.0) instead of selectively. Fix restored selectivity. Row 17 now ranks #1 for 'CK ID' query.

tuningRounds.bsaResultAfter: Pass — entity ranks #1 for CK ID query
tuningRounds.notes: The R2 CSV notes: 'Pass - Fixed by alias boost threshold change (Row 24 fix). Entity now ranks #1 for CK ID query.' The Row 24 fix (SMARTMET alias boost bug) was the same root cause — alias boost was 1.0 for ALL entities.

tuningRounds.description: R2 Row 24 (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY SMARTMET) — 'SMARTMET LLC' now works after alias boost bug fix. 'LLC SMARTMET' (reversed) still partially failing.
tuningRounds.trigger: BSA consultant R2: 'SMARTMET LLC and LLC SMARTMET didnt return main entity'
tuningRounds.algorithmChange: Alias boost bug: was applying score 1.0 to all entities. Fixed to apply 0.50 boost selectively to alias matches only.
tuningRounds.bsaResultAfter: Partial — SMARTMET LLC fixed, LLC SMARTMET (reversed token order) still failing
tuningRounds.notes: Reversed token order (LLC SMARTMET vs SMARTMET LLC) remains an open edge case. The R2 CSV marks this as 'Partial'. This is a known limitation — token order affects score even with bestPairCombination.

tuningRounds.description: YAML migration Phases 1-6: externalized all 56 remaining hardcoded scoring parameters. BSA verified 100/100 after each phase.
tuningRounds.trigger: 41 hardcoded constants remaining across AddressComparer, DateComparer, SupportingInfoScorer, TitleScorer, EntityScorer, NameScorer. Production tuning required recompilation.

changesApplied.rationale: Phase 6 — Alias selection tolerance externalization. Controls how close a second alias must be to beat the primary match.

tuningRounds.notes: Values unchanged — these were externalization passes, not scoring changes. The 100/100 BSA result confirms the migration introduced no behavioral drift.

knownOpenEdgeCases.notes: Reversed token order still scoring below threshold. SMARTMET LLC works. Known limitation of token-pair scoring — legal prefix tokens (LLC) interact poorly when placed first.
R2 Individual Row 26: 'GRIGOR'EV without apostrophe didnt return the sanctioned individual. Analysts frequently omit apostrophes. Marked for retest.

consultantObservations: Search results frequently returned higher volume than OFAC reference — true matches consistently ranked in top results. Higher volume reflects broader matching sensitivity, not recall deficiency.
Hyphen and spacing normalization consistent with OFAC reference behavior.
Result limit (1-100, default 50) is configurable — restricting below 50 may hide valid matches in high-noise searches.
